definitions.explanation: Japan's highest mountain (3,776 meters) and most iconic symbol. An active volcano located on the border of Shizuoka and Yamanashi prefectures.

examples.japanese: {富士山|ふじさん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{登|のぼ}る。
{富士山|ふじさん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{見|み}える。

examples.english: Mt. Fuji last erupted over 300 years ago.

notes:
{富士山|ふじさん} is Japan's highest and most famous mountain.

FACTS:
- Height: 3,776 meters (12,388 feet)
- Location: Border of Shizuoka and Yamanashi prefectures
- Status: Active volcano (last eruption: 1707)
- UNESCO World Heritage Site (2013)

EXPRESSIONS:
- {富士山|ふじさん}に{登|のぼ}る: to climb Mt. Fuji
- {富士|ふじ}{登山|とざん}: climbing Mt. Fuji
